subject.title: Per-account native command prefix for multi-agent slash commands

question: Should Slack multi-account native slash commands be solved with validated account-level `nativeNames` mapping, constrained `nativePrefix` sugar, or documented as unsupported for duplicate native command names?
rationale: Current main has no account-level naming contract, and the two prior unmerged PRs show a real design fork; either implementation expands Slack account config and native command behavior.

options.title: Implement validated `nativeNames`
options.body: Add an explicit per-account mapping surface with duplicate and Slack-name validation, registration and reverse lookup support, docs, and tests.

options.title: Implement constrained `nativePrefix`
options.body: Add prefix sugar with strict lowercase slug validation and no broad dash-stripping fallback, accepting a simpler UX but a second naming abstraction.

options.title: Document duplicate names unsupported
options.body: Leave runtime unchanged and document that multiple Slack apps in one workspace must not register identical native command names.

recommendation.title: Implement validated `nativeNames`
recommendation.body: Add an explicit per-account mapping surface with duplicate and Slack-name validation, registration and reverse lookup support, docs, and tests.

likelyOwner.reason: This owner has the clearest history across Slack native command aliases and the shared command registry surface.
